title: Give checkpoint writing and garbage collection independent timeouts
answers: Why do orphaned VPA checkpoints keep accumulating on large clusters?
Can checkpoint writing timeouts prevent checkpoint cleanup?
How should checkpoint maintenance contexts be scoped?
body:
Symptom: Orphaned VPA checkpoints accumulate when checkpoint writing exhausts its timeout before cleanup starts.
Root cause: vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/routines/recommender.go:recommender.RunOnce previously passed one write-limited context to both operations in recommender.MaintainCheckpoints.
Fix pattern: In vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/routines/recommender.go:recommender.MaintainCheckpoints, create separate timeout contexts for writing and garbage collection from the shared parent; create the cleanup context when cleanup starts.
Constraints: Applies when checkpoint storage is enabled and cleanup is due. Independent child timeouts prevent writing from exhausting cleanup's budget, but both operations remain subject to parent cancellation.
applies: VPA recommender checkpoint maintenance and changes to its context or timeout handling.
